description: "Villo" bike-sharing stations in the Brussels-Capital Region is a dataset listed in Open Data | Ville de Bruxelles - Stad Brussel - City of Brussels, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by JC Decaux. "Villo" bike-sharing stations in the Brussels-Capital Region The Villo self-service bicycle system is available throughout the Brussels-Capital Region. Easy to use, the system allows you to pick up or drop off a bike in just a few moments, wherever and whenever you want. More info:. Coverage: City of Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are bycicle, villo, cyclist, electric, mobility, active mobility. The portal shows 344 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-brussels-be-portal.
